name: e2e-mainnet-legacy
description: Isolated 5.0.1-pinned environment for interacting with mainnet-admin-v2 / PrivateVoting on Alpha Mainnet. See CLAUDE.md's "Account address drift across SDK versions" section for why this exists -- the system's global aztec CLI is 5.2.0, which computes a different (wrong) address for this account. Do not bump these versions without re-verifying address derivation against 0x2abaa993... first.
